full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted 4  suit for permanent injunction in the Court of the then Upazila Munsit Katiadi being Other Class Suit No. 322 of 1983 stating, interalia that the entire suit plot measuring 1.08 acres recorded in CS. Plot No. 1454 under. CS. Khatian No. 834/835 corresponding to S.A. Khatian No. 735/748 originally belonged to Mathura Nath Goswami in 16 annas ownership and it was so recorded in the C.S. Khatian while the names of Sashi Bhusan Dey and Satish Chandra ‘Dey  were record therein as adheres. Subsequently said Mathura Nath Goswami removed Sashi Shusan and Satish Chandra from. bargaders in respect of 68 acres of land from the suit plot by western side and brought the land under his .khas possession. The said Mathura Math Goswami thereafter :settled by way of pattan 232 acres of land including .6.8 acres from:the suit plot with his son's wife Tarulata, the mother .of the plaintiff, following Which the plaintiffs mother owned and possessed the same in her own right while Sashi Bushan and Satish Chandra part possessed .40 decimals of the suit plot by the eastern side, Satish Chandra was a peon in a Government office and he migrated to India in 1.947 and he did not come back. Thereafter out of his 3 sons in du Bushan migrated to India 30 years ago while another son used to party business at Mymensingh town and his 3rd son continued as the bargadar under the plaintiffs father and thereafter under the plaintiff in. respect of 40 acres of the suit plot, by the eastern side. Mathura Nath Goswami died leaving behind plaintiffs father as the only heir to succeed him and on his death and on the death of Tarulata the plaintiff became the owner of the suit plot. The S.A. Khatian has been prepared in the names of the plaintiff and his mother Tarulata and the name of Bidhu Bhusan was wrongly recorded in S.A. Khatian in respect of 40. decimals of-the suit plot. The plaintiff on humanitarian consideration has gifted the defendant No. 1.17 acres of land from the suit plot by a registered deed dated: 29.4.1972 and the defendant No. 1 possess the same. One Abdus Satter and others were bargaders under the plaintiff in respect of 68 decimals of land of the suit plot but eventually the plaintiff removed them from, bargadar ship and brought it under his own cultivation. When the said Abdus Satter Was removed from the bargadarship he out of sheer grudge .obtained on 7.6.76 a kabala from Bidhu Bushan in the benami of one Amiruddin in respect Of .20 decimals of land from the suit plot The plaintiff in order to avoid unwanted complications and disturbance posed by the said Persons elected to file a pre-emption case in respect of the said land and got it pre-empted. Excluding the aforesaid 17 Decimals of land gifted to the school the plaintiff has been in continuous and peaceful possession in 90 decimals of land on mutating the same in his own name and on payment of rent to the Government Acquired Estate. The defendants have no right, title and. possession in the suit plot but they illegally threatened the plaintiff with dispossession on 16.4.83 when the plaintiff had no other alternative but to file the suit for permanent injunction with a prayer for restraining the defendants from disturbing the plaintiff with his possession in the suit land.
